body: Delivering Savings from Large-Energy Users to Customer Savings
More businesses are moving to our state and we’re using that growth to benefit our customers. In August 2026, we announced that, beginning in 2029,
large-load contracts will deliver approximately $950 million in savings to Georgia Power customers,
typical residential customer expected to see $180 in savings per year—significantly more than the $102 per year we committed to in December 2025.
protects customers from costs associated with large-energy users like data centers,

while also allowing necessary infrastructure improvements. This decision protects residential and small commercial customers from additional costs tied to new generation and transmission projects, while also building our state for a brighter future.
